changelog:
• 🎬 Seamless trailer handoff: opening a title from the home screen now keeps the same trailer playing and just scales it to full screen instead of restarting it
• ⏯️ Pausing a trailer no longer tears down the player — resume continues from where it left off
• 🧠 Trailers are now tracked per title, so the detail screen never stops a trailer that already belongs to the title being opened
• ✅ Based on 1.3.2: TextureView main player for Android TV black-screen fix, direct P2P stream routing, and sharper 720p trailer selection
